target_customer: Public transit agencies and city transportation departments that plan routes, on-demand zones and service levels
problem: Transit agencies decide what service to run with slow, manual planning. Ontra generates and compares fixed routes, on-demand zones and frequencies with projected ridership, and adds dispatching and a rider app.
business_model: B2B and government SaaS subscription (one profile states a subscription model)

founders.name: Anthony Trasatti
education: Georgia Tech, PhD in operations research
founders.background_notes: YC page describes both founders as former Google engineers with operations research PhDs from Georgia Tech who focused on transit optimization and built the software behind MARTA Reach (Atlanta) and a Savannah pilot.

founders.name: Connor Riley
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as a former Googler with a Georgia Tech ISyE PhD.

competitors.name: Via (Remix)
competitors.what: Remix SaaS transit planning platform, acquired by Via in 2021, with On-demand Planning added November 2021 to model microtransit tradeoffs
competitors.traction_then: Virginia partnership in June 2023 gave 40+ agencies free access; Via claims 17,000+ planners use Remix (self reported)

technical_complexity.rationale: Transit network optimization, demand modeling and real-time dispatch are operations research problems; the founders have PhD level expertise and prior production experience, which is the barrier for others.

defensibility.rationale: Government procurement, integration with agency operations and specialized algorithms create stickiness, but Via's Remix already held a large installed base.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Via was already offering end-to-end planning with on-demand modeling in 2021 and an installed base of agencies by 2023. No acquisition of Ontra found.

market_need_then: Agencies faced ridership recovery pressure after 2020 and states funded planning tools (Virginia 2023). No company specific demand figures found.

branding.domain_note: Uses ontramobility.com; the .com is the name plus a descriptor. Date not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Practical, data driven and measured; stresses planners stay in control and AI is decision support.

brand_strength.rationale: No press, community or brand coverage found, and the name is confusable with Ontra, an unrelated contract automation company.

outcome_analysis: Ontra Mobility is an active two person YC Summer 2024 company led by PhD founders with prior transit software experience. Its site lists public sector customers and a Transit Tech Lab 2026 cohort, but no verified funding round, revenue or exit was found. The main risks are a long government sales cycle and a larger incumbent, Via, with an established planning platform.
notes: Funding unverified: CB Insights lists a $500K convertible note (September 2024, YC only) and VCBacked lists a seed in January 2025 with YC and Filter Fund VC; both aggregators, no primary source, so no round is recorded. Customer names come from the company site and are not independently confirmed. The YC page says MARTA Reach and a Savannah pilot were built by the founders; search found no third source linking Ontra to MARTA. Via/Remix is sourced from a June 2023 article, a year before the batch, as the closest dated competitor. Completeness pass: the $500K convertible note (CB Insights, YC only, likely the standard deal) and the January 2025 seed (VCBacked, no amount) each rest on a single database and may overlap; no press release confirms either.
